official_scope.current_effective_scope: 2024 Enhanced TOS (PRB Resolution No. 02 s. 2024), amended for professional conduct/ethics by PRB Resolution No. 06 s. 2025 and applied to August 2025/subsequent schedules; current 2026 schedule checked.
official_scope.future_effective_change: No newer future-effective subject regime located on the current PRC board page as checked 2026-09-29.

inventory.title: BJMP Comprehensive Operations Manual Revised 2015
inventory.authority: Bureau of Jail Management and Penology
inventory.version_or_date: Revised 2015 edition; agency policies may update procedures
inventory.supported_role_purpose: Operational source for humane safekeeping, reception, identity/authority checks, classification, and jail operations.

inventory.title: BuCor Mandates and Functions
inventory.authority: Bureau of Corrections, Philippines
inventory.supported_role_purpose: Current agency mandate for safekeeping, reformation, rehabilitation, and reintegration of PDL within BuCor jurisdiction.

inventory.title: BuCor Standard Operating Procedures for Pre-release Reintegration Program
inventory.authority: Bureau of Corrections, Philippines
inventory.supported_role_purpose: Agency source for coordinated pre-release planning and reintegration; changing implementation details are kept bounded.

inventory.title: Republic Act No. 10173, Data Privacy Act of 2012
inventory.authority: Republic of the Philippines; Lawphil text
inventory.version_or_date: Republic Act No. 10173; current implementing guidance must be checked
inventory.supported_role_purpose: Privacy and lawful handling of personal information in investigative and public-safety contexts.

inventory.title: Republic Act No. 11131, Philippine Criminology Profession Act of 2018
inventory.authority: Congress of the Philippines; Lawphil text
inventory.version_or_date: Republic Act No. 11131; amendments must be checked separately
inventory.supported_role_purpose: Professional scope, practice boundaries, Board powers, examination subjects, and professional responsibilities.

inventory.title: Republic Act No. 7438, Rights of Persons Arrested, Detained, or under Custodial Investigation
inventory.authority: Republic of the Philippines; Lawphil text
inventory.supported_role_purpose: Custodial investigation rights, counsel, warnings, reports, confessions, and waiver safeguards.

inventory.title: Republic Act No. 9165, Comprehensive Dangerous Drugs Act of 2002
inventory.authority: Republic of the Philippines; Lawphil text
inventory.version_or_date: Republic Act No. 9165 as amended; current text and implementing rules must be checked
inventory.supported_role_purpose: Bounded source for drug-law terminology and evidence-handling concepts; volatile thresholds and penalties are not used in this batch.

inventory.title: Republic Act No. 9745, Anti-Torture Act of 2009
inventory.authority: Republic of the Philippines; Lawphil text
inventory.supported_role_purpose: Absolute prohibition and safeguards against torture and cruel, inhuman, or degrading treatment.

inventory.title: Act No. 3815, Revised Penal Code
inventory.authority: Republic of the Philippines; Lawphil text
inventory.version_or_date: Act No. 3815 as amended; current provisions must be checked for each sensitive proposition
inventory.supported_role_purpose: Foundational source for general criminal-law elements, persons liable, stages, circumstances, and penalties. Version-sensitive where amendment affects the proposition.

inventory.title: Revised Rules of Criminal Procedure, Rules 110–127
inventory.authority: Supreme Court of the Philippines; Lawphil text
inventory.supported_role_purpose: Procedural source for prosecution, arraignment, rights, trial sequence, search and seizure, and related criminal procedure.

inventory.title: Revised Rules on Evidence, Rules 128–134
inventory.authority: Supreme Court of the Philippines; Lawphil text
inventory.supported_role_purpose: Evidence definition, relevance, admissibility, authentication, weight, and proof standards. Currentness must be checked against later Supreme Court issuances.

inventory.title: Crime Scene Investigation: A Guide for Law Enforcement
inventory.authority: National Institute of Justice / National Forensic Science Technology Center
inventory.supported_role_purpose: Operational guidance for scene safety, documentation, processing, evidence preservation, packaging, transport, and submission.

inventory.title: Crime Scene Investigation: Guides for Law Enforcement
inventory.authority: National Institute of Justice
inventory.supported_role_purpose: Practice guidance emphasizing methodical preservation, contamination control, agency policy, and jurisdictional limits.

inventory.title: Five Things About Deterrence
inventory.authority: National Institute of Justice
inventory.supported_role_purpose: Evidence-informed deterrence principles, especially certainty of apprehension versus severity of punishment.

inventory.title: Firearms and Toolmarks Research
inventory.authority: National Institute of Standards and Technology
inventory.supported_role_purpose: Firearm/toolmark comparison, measurement quality, uncertainty, databases, and limits of examiner judgment.

inventory.title: Forensic Science Standards Program
inventory.authority: National Institute of Standards and Technology / OSAC
inventory.supported_role_purpose: Scientific standards, quality, reproducibility, validation, and standards-development source.

inventory.title: Scientific Foundation Reviews
inventory.authority: National Institute of Standards and Technology
inventory.supported_role_purpose: Scientific-foundation, reliability, limitations, uncertainty, and communication source for forensic interpretation.

inventory.title: Introduction to Criminology: An Equity Lens
inventory.authority: Open Oregon Educational Resources; Peterson and VanderPyl
inventory.supported_role_purpose: Instructional source for criminological theory, measurement, learning, social structure, prevention, and critical interpretation.

inventory.title: Theoretical Perspectives on Deviance and Crime
inventory.authority: OpenStax, Introduction to Sociology 3e
inventory.supported_role_purpose: Open academic source for strain, social disorganization, conflict, labeling, differential association, and control perspectives.

inventory.title: PRC Professional Regulatory Board of Criminology board page
inventory.authority: Professional Regulation Commission / Professional Regulatory Board of Criminology
inventory.supported_role_purpose: Current PRC index for Board resolutions, TOS documents, ethics material, and current board notices. Scope only.

inventory.title: Enhanced Tables of Specifications for the Licensure Examination for Criminologists
inventory.authority: Professional Regulation Commission; Professional Regulatory Board of Criminology
inventory.supported_role_purpose: Enhanced TOS reference aligned with the Philippine Qualifications Framework.

inventory.title: Code of Ethical and Professional Conduct of Philippine Registered Criminologists
inventory.authority: Professional Regulation Commission / Professional Regulatory Board of Criminology
inventory.version_or_date: PRB Resolution No. 07 s. 2024; effective after publication
inventory.supported_role_purpose: Current professional conduct source for human rights, public interest, integrity, confidentiality, independence, scientific principles, and humane treatment.

inventory.title: Adjustments in the Schedule of the Criminology and Correctional Administration Subjects
inventory.authority: Professional Regulation Commission
inventory.supported_role_purpose: Current six-area order and weights; scope/program source, not substantive instruction.

inventory.title: Parole and Probation Quality Manual
inventory.authority: Philippine Parole and Probation Administration
inventory.supported_role_purpose: Philippine source for individualized treatment, supervision, rehabilitation, and community integration.
